found you on linkedin - tanmay goel, transforming mental healthcare in india. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/tanmaygoel

This is me : https://www.linkedin.com/in/tanmaygoel13/

Well my main work for the past few months involved working CRM systems using Odoo and open source CRM software. Apart from that building multi agentic Graph RAG systems using Neo4j graphical database and connecting that system to our CRM odoo software for human in the loop review of intricate details.

odoo crm + graph rag with neo4j... that's some serious tech stack. you're basically building the brain that connects all the dots for customer data. human-in-the-loop review means you actually care about accuracy, not just throwing ai at everything and hoping it works.

what made you dive into the ai/ml space? were you always a data person or did something specific pull you in?

Well i was interested in the deep learning stuff from the starting, I have an intermediate level knowledge in deep learning/machine learning related stuff. 
My initial work at this company actually started with doing literature reviews for their main AI model, and contributing towards prepping the architecture of their custom model. So basically I have ready many research papers, and have gained an extensive knowledge about the intricate working of multimodal LMMs.
And then they put me in the developer role, where I started with building Instagram toolings using meta graph api. So it was like they wanted to create a marketing and handle management sort of thing for the user's insta handle using the API features that META provides and not by illegal scraping.
Then they got a pilot partner that goes by Deveres Auction house, which wanted a system in which there can be a source of truth CRM where all of the data can be viewed collectively from different sources extracted and imported in a structured schema. So we started building scrapers, I worked with browser-use, firecrawl, crawl4ai, byult scraping agents and odoo CRM interface and delivered a product in which the data was getting ingested from all the available sources at their end and was being shown in our odoo interface. 
Then we started building useful analytics that we can get from this source of truth database that we have created.
But before completing this analytics part I was shifted to another project with another pilot partner in which I had to build a system where it takes the pilot partner's data dump, decided the graphical database schema, extract entities from the data dump and store it in a neo4j graphical database. Now generate audit queries marking the present inconsistencies violating some set business rules like an artwork should have a single artist but it had two artist, so it was pointed out by the system in the form of an audit query which references the source document from which this data record was created, and an human agent(which is the staff here) reviews it and accepts or rejects or improves it. so all of this was developed using google adk and neo4j, and was a multi agentic system.

Well I would say AI engineer uses the models just from a user point of view, he performs works of using models directly in the Agentic Pipeline. And ML Engineer has to sometimes dive into the intricate workings of the model to choose the correct model, while an AI engineer might use high level benchmarks to choose the best model.

but the real work is personalization - generic outreach gets ignored

but the hardest part isn't the tech - it's avoiding spam filters and actually getting replies

most tools use rotating proxies, browser automation, and rate limiting to avoid detection
